intent: Direct player sprite reskins with atlas-level simplicity. No splash illustration used as a reference.

sprites.name: gwenn
sprites.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT image 1 directly into a very simple RPG overworld character reskin. Image 1 is the ACTUAL PLAYER SPRITE, not just loose inspiration: copy its exact frontal standing pose, silhouette, head size, tiny short body, arm positions, feet and coarse pixel grid. Image 2 shows original in-game atlas NPCs and is only a simplicity/style check. Do not use any illustrated splash art. The real sprite occupies only 17 pixels wide by 24 pixels tall in a 32x32 cell, with a 14-pixel head and approximately 10-pixel body INCLUDING feet. Every logical pixel should be one large SOLID square, about 12 screen pixels like the reference. Head and body must NOT get taller or wider than the player. Keep the player sprite's feet positions. Two eyes are just ONE dark logical pixel each, no detailed face. Flat dark outlines, 8-10 flat colours, only one flat shadow colour per garment. No fabric folds, textures, gradients, hatching, laces, seams, fingers or expressive anime eyes. One character on a genuine transparent square background, no ground shadow, labels or backdrop. Reskin as Gwenn: keep the player's EXACT cap silhouette but recolour it charcoal black; replace the hat logo by plain flat black. Two very short simple black hair strands on the sides of the face, only one pixel wide. A black scarf covers the nose and mouth, leaving just two tiny eyes in a narrow skin strip, no face below. Plain black top and plain black short legs, tiny boots. Hands in the SAME positions as the player: a tiny red-and-white Ball of just TWO or THREE logical pixels in one hand, a single grey pixel suggesting a vape in the other. Black clothing is a simple flat shape, NOT a detailed coat. Do not add hair volume, accessories, pockets, belt or detailed shoes. This must look like the provided player sprite wearing a simple new outfit, not a miniature illustration.
